verdict.rationale: Caveman ships a skill, and its CLI wraps several agents, so the skill-authoring axis applies. Nothing in the evidence says its skills conform to the open Agent Skills specification or that the skill folder is portable as a spec-compliant artifact. Multi-agent support comes from the CLI wrapper, which is adjacent to spec compliance and does not establish it.

support.subject: As a developer, skills follow the open Agent Skills specification so the same skill folder is valid beyond this one vendor's tooling
